applicant.name: Dr. Pieter de Vries
applicant.organisation: University Medical Center Utrecht, Julius Center

request.purpose: Scientific research on medication use and treatment gaps in routine care.
request.question: What is the mean eGFR of patients with chronic kidney disease per hospital?
definitions: Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient; patients without an eGFR are left out.
Report per hospital: patients with chronic kidney disease who have an eGFR and their mean eGFR, one decimal.
